answer_3.quote: For each concept C we first ask the model to report its notion of (a) the average (A(C)) and (b) the ideal (I(C)) ... We then give a sample prompt for concept C to get (c) sample (S(C)). ... Exemplars are rated on a 7‑point scale ranging from not at all average/ideal/'good example' (0) to completely average/ideal/'good example' (7). The prototypicality score is derived by averaging three entities, which measure the degree to which the given prototype is a "good example", "paradigmatic example", or "prototypical example".
